verdict.rationale: Ramp documents that every write operation, including approvals and edits made through MCP or the CLI, lands automatically in the Ramp audit log with attribution. An `audit_logs:read` scope is exposed on the live MCP server, and policy enforcement and policy-grounded approval recommendations are documented. However, the audit-log evidence comes almost entirely from the AI-agent guides, and nothing describes a per-expense history covering edits, approvals and policy-check outcomes, or how it holds up in an external audit. Missing for 10: documentation of per-expense audit history across all channels (UI and human actions), explicit logging of policy-check results, audit export or retention guarantees for external auditors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
